title: Readiness Surge Allocator — KPI & Launch Playlet
body:
Purpose:
A compact, actionable playlet to allocate surge capacity, track launch KPIs in rolling windows, and provide a single-pane readiness checklist for small to medium feature launches (pilot -> 50k MAU). Meant to be used during the T-minus 4 week to T-plus 2 week window.

How to use this file:
- Copy the KPI rows into the sprint board (owner + cadence columns).
- Run the surge allocator every 48 hours during traffic ramp. Update actuals and reassign burst owners if SLA risk > 10%.

Top-level objectives:
- Keep 95th pct latency for "generate" < 400ms for 90% of requests in pilot region.
- Maintain cost-per-1k tokens change <= +20% vs baseline.
- No customer-facing degraded tiers for > 10 minutes during the ramp.

KPI tracker (snapshot format):
KPI | Target | Owner | Cadence | Current | Risk (low/med/high)
Activation conversion (free->paid, 7d) | +8% vs baseline | Marta N. | daily | +5% | medium
95th generate latency (pilot) | <400ms | SRE oncall | hourly | 420ms | high
Error rate (5xx) | <0.5% | Platform eng | hourly | 0.3% | low
Avg token cost per 1k | <= baseline *1.2 | Finance owner | daily | +18% | medium
Model fallback rate | <2% | Serving runtime | hourly | 0.7% | low
Adoption of canary path | >= 20% requests | Product ops | daily | 12% | medium

Surge allocator quick matrix (decision rules):
- If 95th latency breach AND error rate > 0.8% -> immediate partial traffic rollback to canary model variant + open incident channel.
- If token cost delta > +25% for more than 2 reporting windows -> throttle non-critical background jobs and trigger quantization tuning task.
- If sustained >10% conversion drop during ramp -> enable expanded fallback and pause paid-only experiments.

Capacity slots (rolling 48h table to run in parallel with SRE cadence):
Slot | Purpose | Owner | Pre-warm action | Trigger to scale up
S1 | Pilot traffic buffer (x1.5) | Diego A. | pre-warm 2 GPU nodes | >75% pilot node CPU for 5m
S2 | Canary reserve (x0.5) | Serving runtime | keep hot cache + KV snapshot | canary error > 0.5%
S3 | Emergency spillover | Platform eng | standby infra credits | cross-region failover engaged

Launch readiness checklist (T-minus 7 days -> launch):
- T-7: Complete load-run smoke test (owner: SRE). Confirm 95th latency baseline.
- T-5: Confirm rollback & fallback playbooks in Console (owner: Product ops).
- T-3: Finalize KPI alert thresholds + oncall rotations (owner: Platform eng + SRE).
- T-1: Sanity traffic cut (10% traffic) and audit logs review (owner: Compliance).
- Launch: Broadcast traffic shift plan, open #launch-ops, start surge cadence.
- T+1 day: Daily cadence 0900/1700 status notes; T+3 days: convert to 0900 only if metrics stable.

Ownership roster (single-line contact + backfill):
- Product ops lead: Priya K. (priya@redwood.ai) / backup: Ethan M.
- SRE oncall: Sana I. / backup: Diego
- Serving runtime owner: Marta N. / backup: Platform eng
- Finance contact: Lucas P. / backup: Finance ops

Pre-launch runbook snippets (quick commands & checks):
- Check canary traffic: curl -H "X-Canary: true" https://api.redwood.ai/health
- Validate token bucket: ./scripts/token-cost-compare --baseline id=2024-11-01
- KV snapshot restore test: run ./infra/kv-check.sh --restore-preview

Communications plan (short):
- #launch-ops Slack channel: ops comms + incident anchor.
- Email template for customers in pilot if SLA > 30m: [link to template].
- Stakeholder daily sync: 09:00 standup (15m), summary note to execs by 10:30.

Risks & mitigations (short list):
- Risk: Unexpected model regression at scale. Mitigation: Canary routing + immediate rollback button; run small evals against production prompts.
- Risk: Surging token costs due to longer prompts. Mitigation: enable prefix caching and token limits per session.
- Risk: Cross-region failover permission gaps. Mitigation: pre-authorize runbook and test during T-7.

Unresolved questions (to decide by T-3):
- Do we enable automatic quantization toggles on cost delta > 20%? (product + infra decision)
- Is expanded audit retention needed for pilot customers for 30 days? (security/compliance)
- Which SLA tier gets priority burst if capacity constrained? (commercial + prodops)

Post-launch retrospectives (template):
- Timeline of events (T-1 -> T+7)
- KPI deltas vs baseline (conversion, latency, cost)
- Actions taken and time-to-resolution metrics
- Open action items and owners (30/60/90 day closures)

Notes to self:
- Keep the surge allocator as a 1-pager in Console for quick access.
- Consider a lightweight sheet backed by metrics API for auto-populating Current values.
- This doc will be the canonical short-playlet during pilot; move to final-playbooks when mature.

References:
- Confluence: PRODOPS-114 (detailed runbooks)
- Jira: PROD-982 (surge allocator epic)
- GitHub: inference-rollout#458 (scripts and infra templates)

-- End playlet --
